summary: ACCEPT. Fresh iteration-3 review independently rechecked the complete Story 12.2 plan set against the corrected 43 Functional Requirements, nine Success Criteria, BMad Story 12.2 and Story 12.3 boundaries, Constitution, Ubiquitous Language, PRD and dated-overlay precedence, approved August Windows-host runtime architecture, inherited Story 12.1 contracts, and current production/test seams. PR2-001 is fully closed: canonical-envelope sections 3, 4.2, 4.3, 4.7, and 6 define distinct versioned CodeGraph and Java proof domains; exact ascending field tags and order; UUID, String, Bytes, Boolean, UInt64, Enum, and nullable String types; explicit zero, false, true, Null, Ready, NotApplicable, Complete, Usable, and Stdio handling; approved-state invariants; and exhaustive derived and volatile exclusions. Manifest tags 9 and 10 reference only CodeGraphProofIdentityHash and JavaReadinessIdentityHash. Measured durations and volatile process, timing, diagnostic, resource, protocol, path, and workspace telemetry have no edge into proof, manifest, UUID, or replay identity; bounded observed durations and permitted audit observations remain first-commit metadata and are not overwritten on replay. The store contract requires independent relational reconstruction from persisted typed fields rather than trust in opaque hashes. Canonical-envelope section 6 and quickstart sections 3 and 5 require committed literal Complete, Ready, and NotApplicable proof vectors, an independent reader/reconstructor, repeated preparation with different durations and byte-identical identities, excluded-telemetry invariance, and conflict or integrity rejection for every stable predicate, binding, null, ordering, ordinal, or byte mutation. PR-001 remains closed by FR-031, AD-3, the failure table, and golden case 5; PR-002 remains closed by FR-034/FR-035, AD-5/AD-6, the ordinal matrix, relational uniqueness, projections, and interleaving vectors; PR-003 is closed by the complete tagged binary grammar, noncircular dependency graph, SHA-256 and UUIDv8 construction, literal vectors, and independent reconstruction; PR-004 remains closed by FR-029-FR-032, the lowercase UUID-D ordinal comparator, exact high-value candidate/seed definition, retain/fill/cap semantics, and golden cases 1-4. The plan preserves CodeGraph @colbymchenry/codegraph@1.5.0, JDT LS jdt-language-server-1.61.0-202608141332, Java 21, StreamJsonRpc 2.25.29 over stdio, PostgreSQL-only Docker, and no CodeGraphContext. It is feasible through additive Core, Infrastructure, Shared, Web, migration, PostgreSQL, real-tool, and neutral-fixture seams; safe XML capability prohibitions and hard bounds are explicit; pair approval and replay are atomic and mutation-free; authorization and failure mappings are closed; and Worker execution, navigate_code, Scan Job Execution policy, Documents, Edges, Uncertainties, Cross-Repository Resolution, Pass 2, Chat, and demo-only state remain excluded. The planned-change matrix identifies parsing/filtering, ordering/splitting, handoff/persistence, analysis-tool, and dated-PRD triggers with affected plan headings, clauses, effects, intent, exact scope, and remaining gates. Read-only evidence used Get-Content -Raw and bounded line inspection over the definition and authority set, rg searches over requirements/runtime/proof/replay/security/source seams, Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 over all 16 owned paths, git rev-parse HEAD, and git status --short. The observed HEAD is the reviewed commit and all measured hashes match this verdict boundary. No file, state, verdict, index, branch, commit, or Git history was changed. This ACCEPT authorizes the plan-review gate only; repository policy now requires the root to obtain explicit planned-change authorization before task generation, with all later task self-review, definition review, TDD, convergence, quality review, conditional E2E, security, migration, final verification, checkpoint, and commit gates still in force.
